mentions.name: Monofocus
mentions.description: This app is a task manager that helps the user focus on one task at a time. It implements picking a single task and setting a timer, with accumulated time spent on the task incrementing. Data is stored locally in the browser, with an optional sync feature, and it ships as a PWA.
mentions.problem: Staying focused on one task at a time instead of juggling many.
mentions.audience: Made for the author's own use to stay focused on one task at a time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Yup, it's another task manager.

I made it for myself to help me focus on one task at a time, hence the name.

It implements my number one productivity hack of picking a task and setting a timer. Time spent on a task increments.

Data is stored locally in the browser although there is a sync option i wouldn't shake a stick at if I hadn't built this myself.

Plus it's a PWA! Those are lovely.
